_comment_outlook: Gmail SMTP often delivers to Gmail but Outlook/Microsoft 365 may quarantine external senders. Recipients should check Junk, Other, and (for work/school) admin Quarantine. Long-term: send from an @yourdomain.edu mailbox (Google Workspace or M365 SMTP) aligned with SPF/DKIM.
_comment_smtp: For production, prefer a department mailbox (e.g. Google Workspace iqadms@yourdomain.edu). Gmail requires From and Username to match; use a dedicated account, not a personal one. Links in invites use App:PublicUrl only.
